title: MagnoliaMC
description: MagnoliaMC is a whimsical, regal SMP with a bunch of unique features to offer and gorgeous terratonic + terralith biomes. Affinities change the way you play and introduce new gameplay, and introduce new challenges!
body:
MagnoliaMC is a whimsical, cozy and friendly server with unique features and custom gameplay style. Affinities change the way you play and introduce new gameplay, and introduce new challenges! Come join our friendly community and start your next journey today!

Bringing you gorgeous terrain with terralith and tectonic, your imagination is the limit as you build beautiful creations, develop the economy and find a community that is wholesome and full of everyday magic!
